page.layout: One page of text, single column of Greek paradigms with braces; running head at top; page number top left. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: ἠδίς ... ἠδύτερος, ἠδύτατος ... ἠδίων, ἠδὶς (paradigm of ἡδύς, comparative and superlative forms in braces)
παχύς, παχύτερος, παχύτατος, παχίων, πάχιςˑ πάσσων (paradigm with braces)
ταχύς, ταχύτερος, ταχύτατος, ταχίων, τάχις, θάσσων vel θάττων
main_text.head: Nonnulla tantùm irregulariter comparantur, ut:
main_text.p: ἀγαθός, ἀμείνων, ἀγαθώτατος; ἀρείων, ἄρις; βελτίων, βέλτις; κρείττων, κρείττις; λωίων, λῷς
main_text.l: κακός, κακίων, κάκις; χείρων, χέιρις; χερείων

page.notes: Greek paradigm text is reproduced from a scanned early printed grammar; several accents and the braces' grouping are approximate. Two lines of the first paradigms and the superlative forms of ἡδύς and παχύς are uncertain. Catchword "λα-" at bottom right is a catchword, not text. Page is mostly Greek; the Greek is transcribed only approximately and flagged for checking.
